note: Niger: nationals of the ECOWAS states, Burkina Faso and Mali enter without a visa, those of Chad, Mauritania, Morocco and Tunisia for 3 months, Hong Kong's for 14 days; Emiratis get a visa on arrival; everyone else needs a visa from a mission (or a pre-approved one on arrival at Niamey, not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Niger
sources.said: Visitors to Niger must obtain a visa from one of the Nigerien diplomatic missions unless they come from one of the visa exempt countries. ... Citizens of the following countries or regions can visit Niger without a visa: All ECOWAS member states Burkina Faso Chad (3 months) Hong Kong (14 days) Mali Mauritania (3 months) Morocco (3 months) Tunisia (3 months) ... citizens of the United Arab Emirates holding an ordinary passport can obtain a visa on arrival.
